parameters.query:
with ordered_samples as (
  select
    gf.market_id,
    gf.measured_at,
    gf.target_hz,
    gf.actual_hz,
    lag(gf.measured_at) over (partition by gf.market_id order by gf.measured_at) as previous_measured_at
  from energy_data.grid_frequency_measurements gf
  where gf.measured_at >= now() - interval '10 minutes'
), previous_state as (
  select
    max(last_source_timestamp) as last_source_timestamp,
    coalesce(max((state ->> 'deviation_seconds')::numeric), 0) as previous_deviation_seconds
  from energy_data.workflow_state
  where workflow_name = 'grid_time_deviation_calculated'
), pending_samples as (
  select o.*
  from ordered_samples o
  cross join previous_state ps
  where o.previous_measured_at is not null
    and (ps.last_source_timestamp is null or o.measured_at > ps.last_source_timestamp)
), integrated as (
  select
    p.market_id,
    p.measured_at,
    ps.previous_deviation_seconds
      + sum(
          ((p.actual_hz - p.target_hz) / p.target_hz)
          * extract(epoch from (p.measured_at - p.previous_measured_at))
        ) over (partition by p.market_id order by p.measured_at rows unbounded preceding)
      as deviation_seconds
  from pending_samples p
  cross join previous_state ps
), calculated_rows as (
  select
    s.id as source_id,
    i.market_id,
    i.measured_at,
    i.measured_at + make_interval(secs => i.deviation_seconds::double precision) as grid_time,
    i.deviation_seconds::numeric(12,3) as deviation_seconds
  from integrated i
  cross join energy_data.data_sources s
  where s.code = 'calculated'
), upserted as (
  insert into energy_data.grid_time_deviation_measurements (
    source_id,
    market_id,
    measured_at,
    grid_time,
    deviation_seconds,
    source_published_at,
    quality,
    calculation_method
  )
  select
    source_id,
    market_id,
    measured_at,
    grid_time,
    deviation_seconds,
    measured_at,
    'calculated',
    'frequency_integral_approximation'
  from calculated_rows
  on conflict (source_id, market_id, measured_at) do update
  set
    grid_time = excluded.grid_time,
    deviation_seconds = excluded.deviation_seconds,
    source_published_at = excluded.source_published_at,
    quality = excluded.quality,
    calculation_method = excluded.calculation_method,
    ingested_at = now()
  returning source_id, measured_at, deviation_seconds
), latest_upserted as (
  select source_id, measured_at, deviation_seconds
  from upserted
  order by measured_at desc
  limit 1
), state_upsert as (
  insert into energy_data.workflow_state (
    workflow_name,
    source_id,
    last_success_at,
    last_source_timestamp,
    state
  )
  select
    'grid_time_deviation_calculated',
    source_id,
    now(),
    measured_at,
    jsonb_build_object('deviation_seconds', deviation_seconds)
  from latest_upserted
  on conflict (workflow_name) do update
  set
    source_id = excluded.source_id,
    last_success_at = excluded.last_success_at,
    last_source_timestamp = excluded.last_source_timestamp,
    state = excluded.state,
    updated_at = now()
  returning 1
)
insert into energy_data.ingestion_runs (
  workflow_name,
  source_id,
  finished_at,
  status,
  records_read,
  records_written
)
select
  'grid_time_deviation_calculated',
  coalesce((select source_id from latest_upserted), (select id from energy_data.data_sources where code = 'calculated')),
  now(),
  case when exists (select 1 from latest_upserted) then 'success' else 'partial' end,
  (select count(*)::integer from pending_samples),
  (select count(*)::integer from upserted);
